5 Detoxifying Decoctions or equivalent blight medicine (Pitywort + Syrupwort Leaf, or ~500 G each from Philbert's Sundries)

best_outcome.summary: Fulfil Daphne's escalating requests across several days.
steps: Combine sunbloom and noonbloom into a Bunch of Flowers and deliver it.
Obtain and deliver Silver Ore.
Sleep/wait a day and return.
Procure and deliver two pieces of Gold Ore.
Deliver medicine that treats the blighted debilitation (Detoxifying Decoction or Panacea).

bad_outcome.summary: No alternate outcome is documented — Fextralife states the quest has a single path.
bad_outcome.how_it_happens: The only real loss state is entering the Unmoored World mid-chain.
bad_outcome.consequences: Quest and the Golden Trove Beetle are lost, and 'House of the Blue Sunbright' never unlocks.

along_the_way: Unlocks the follow-up quest 'House of the Blue Sunbright'.
The Golden Trove Beetle is a permanent carry-capacity increase — worth not skipping.
gotchas: The Bunch of Flowers wilts after one in-game day. Deliver it straight away or park it in storage, which stops the decay.
CONFLICT on prerequisite: PowerPyx requires 'In Dragon's Wake'; Fextralife requires only reaching the Slums.
CONFLICT on quantity: Fextralife says 'find medicine' without a count; PowerPyx specifies 5 Detoxifying Decoctions.
Both sources carry player reports of a bug where Daphne keeps asking for flowers she has already been given.

name: The Heel of History
how_to_start: Donate to Kendrick, the beggar outside The Gracious Hand in the Vernworth Slums. Fextralife says donate food twice; Game8 says roughly 1,000 Gold plus food. After enough donations he asks you to find the missing boy Malcolm.
prerequisites: Reach Vernworth and have gold/food to donate.
timing: Vernworth, available early. Worth doing before 'The Caged Magistrate' because it opens the Vaults.
bring: Food items to donate (Dried Spuds can be picked up inside The Gracious Hand)
About 1,000 Gold

best_outcome.summary: Trace Malcolm through the slum children, follow Kendrick into the Gracious Hand's Vaults, and find Malcolm in the hidden archive.
steps: Donate food/gold to Kendrick outside The Gracious Hand until he asks for help.
Question three children: Harvey and Rick north-east of The Gracious Hand, then Aimee inside.
Report back to Kendrick.
Follow him to the ruined tower; he clears the rubble over the underground entrance.
Descend into the Gracious Hand's Vaults and take the right-hand path around the locked door.
Find Malcolm in the octagonal chamber and follow him to the underground library.
rewards: Dragon Panacea x1 (Game8) / Panacea + Spider Venom Sac (Fextralife)

bad_outcome.summary: No failure branch is documented.

along_the_way: Discovering the Vaults here is what makes 'The Caged Magistrate' progress smoothly later.
Going back into the archive after the quest gets you the Logistician's Tome and Forager's Tome from Kendrick and Malcolm.
gotchas: Fextralife user reports say talking to Aimee before Kendrick can break progression - do the boys first, then Kendrick's prompt, then Aimee.
Sources conflict on the item reward (Dragon Panacea vs Panacea + Spider Venom Sac) and on the exact donation requirement.

name: The Importance of Aiding Ernesto
how_to_start: After starting the main quest 'Halls of the First Dawn' in the Unmoored World, travel to Volcanic Island Camp and speak with Ernesto near the northern gate.
prerequisites: Have started 'Halls of the First Dawn'; reach Volcanic Island Camp in the Unmoored World.
timing: Unmoored World / post-Legacy only. Runs concurrently with 'Halls of the First Dawn'.
bring: A Portcrystal and Ferrystones (the escorting is slow otherwise)
Wakestones — the Unmoored World is hostile and your escortees are fragile

best_outcome.summary: Evacuate all three islanders — Gautstafr, Cliodhna and Lamond — back to Ernesto at the camp.
steps: Speak to Ernesto at the northern gate of Volcanic Island Camp.
Head west to Windwalker's Home and convince Gautstafr and Cliodhna to evacuate.
Escort them back to camp — consider physically carrying Gautstafr, since his back slows him down.
Intercept Lamond on his way to the hot geysers at Geyser Hamlet and convince him to leave; any dialogue option works.
Report back to Ernesto.

bad_outcome.summary: Lamond is left behind.
bad_outcome.how_it_happens: Reporting back to Ernesto without having convinced Lamond, or failing to intercept him.
bad_outcome.consequences: Fextralife notes abandoning Lamond triggers a different response from Ernesto. The concrete mechanical difference — whether rewards change — is not documented anywhere I found.

along_the_way: Gautstafr and Cliodhna are the same NPCs from 'Put a Spring in Thy Step'; Lamond is from 'The Sotted Sage'. If you never did those quests, expect these NPCs to be unfamiliar — but both sources still describe the evacuation as running the same way.
Building affinity with Lamond earlier (e.g. via The Sotted Sage) makes convincing him easier.
gotchas: CONFLICT on time pressure: Fextralife says the quest is 'not affected by the passage of time' but marks its cancellation trigger as unknown ('??'); PowerPyx records no time limit at all. Neither publishes a deadline. HOWEVER — the Unmoored World as a whole is on a global countdown where regions are consumed one by one, and no source I found states whether that countdown can eat this quest. This is a genuine gap: I set is_missable to false because no source claims otherwise, but I would not treat that as settled.
Carrying Gautstafr is faster than escorting him on foot.
Lamond must be intercepted en route to the geysers — he is not stationary.

name: The Ornate Box
how_to_start: Speak to Sven in the Merchant Quarter of Vernworth, near the merchant stalls below the fountain.
prerequisites: Complete 'Seat of the Sovran' AND choose to LIE when Norman asks you about Sven.
timing: Runs over three in-game days of returning to the fountain.

missable.window: Becomes unavailable after completing the main quest 'Feast of Deception'.
missable.warning: BLUNT, DOUBLE TRAP: (1) if you told Norman the truth about Sven, this quest never opens at all — that choice is made much earlier and cannot be undone; (2) even if it opened, Feast of Deception closes it permanently. It also feeds you the Courtly Attire that Feast of Deception itself requires.

bring: 1,000 G for the Ornate Box (800 G if you have the 'Medicament Predicament' discount)

best_outcome.summary: Buy the Ornate Box from Auriol and give Sven the box (not cash), then collect recompense at the fountain over three days.
steps: Do 'Medicament Predicament' first for the shop discount (box drops to 800 G).
Buy the Ornate Box from Auriol.
Give Sven the BOX, not 1,000 Gold.
Return to the fountain on each of the next three in-game days.
rewards: Day 3: Ferrystone, Courtly Breeches, Courtly Tunic, 4,000 G

bad_outcome.summary: Handing Sven 1,000 Gold instead of the box.
bad_outcome.how_it_happens: Choosing the cash option at the hand-off.
bad_outcome.consequences: Slightly worse rewards, and you forgo the discount play. Not catastrophic, but strictly inferior.

along_the_way: The Day 3 Courtly Tunic and Courtly Breeches are exactly what 'Feast of Deception' and 'The Stolen Throne' need — this is the painless way to get them.
gotchas: The lie-to-Norman prerequisite is a genuinely hidden gate set during 'Seat of the Sovran'. If Julian told the truth, this quest is already gone.
Single-source (Game8) on the day-by-day reward table; missable window corroborated by Game8's missables page and PowerPyx's index.

name: The Phantom Oxcart
region: Vermund (starts in Vernworth) — resolves in Battahl (Flamebearer Palace)
how_to_start: After completing the main quest 'Nation of the Lambent Flame' and reaching Battahl, return to Vermund and pass the West Vernworth Oxcart Station (Merchant Quarter); overhearing two NPCs finish discussing a night-running 'phantom oxcart' triggers it. Alternatively, speak with Wilhelmina at Rose Chateau Bordelrie — reportedly more reliable after you have the Myrmecoleon Card — or with Captain Brant.
prerequisites: Complete 'Nation of the Lambent Flame' and reach Battahl. Destructoid instead lists 'Feast of Deception' plus visiting the Beastren area of Battahl.
timing: After Nation of the Lambent Flame, back in Vermund. Investigation steps require night.

missable.window: Fextralife's master list flags it (!). Its quest page says only that the quest 'reportedly becomes unavailable after progressing far into later main quests' — it does NOT name the specific closing main quest, and no other source I checked (PowerPyx, Game8, Destructoid) names one either. The universal outer bound is Legacy, since the quest needs Vernworth, Captain Brant and a working oxcart route.
missable.warning: Do this as soon as you are back in Vermund after Nation of the Lambent Flame — it carries a missable flag and the exact closing main quest is not documented by any source.

bring: Ability to rest to nightfall (bench or inn)
A spare slot in mind for going fully unequipped — no weapons, no armour, no lantern

best_outcome.summary: Infiltrate the smuggling oxcart disguised as a pawn, ride it all the way to Flamebearer Palace, and bring the Labor Requisition Orders back to Brant — this is the branch that earns the trophy.
steps: Rest until night, then take the road northeast/northwest out of Vernworth and find the stopped oxcart. Do NOT approach the oxcart or the soldier too soon after the cutscene, and do not let yourself be seen — the driver flees permanently if spotted.
The soldier Navil flees; chase and grab him (R2). Choose the bribe for 5,000 G, or escort him to prison. Either way you get the Merchant's Document.
Take it to Captain Brant at the Stardrop Inn at night. He offers two routes: follow the oxcart, or infiltrate it.
Choose infiltration. Unequip ALL gear including your lantern, order your pawns to wait, and approach the driver Mansenn from behind — never cut in front of him.
Board as a disguised pawn. Fight the goblin raid BAREHANDED — re-equipping anything ends the disguise and the driver leaves.
At Checkpoint Rest Town, take the guards' beating without fighting back.
At Flamebearer Palace, re-equip, defeat the guards, and take the Labor Requisition Orders.
Return to Captain Brant.
rewards: (+5,000 G if you took Navil's bribe)

bad_outcome.summary: Being spotted early kills the quest outright; following the oxcart instead of riding it completes the quest but loses the trophy.
bad_outcome.how_it_happens: Approaching the oxcart or Navil too soon after the cutscene, or being seen — the driver flees permanently. During the ride: re-equipping any gear, running in front of Mansenn, or resisting the beating at Checkpoint Rest Town each break the disguise. Choosing Brant's 'follow the oxcart' option forfeits the trophy.
bad_outcome.consequences: A blown infiltration loses the trophy at minimum; a spooked driver can end the quest for the playthrough.

along_the_way: The Navil bribe choice is a clean +5,000 G with no documented downstream penalty.

This quest is widely reported as buggy — Siliconera published a dedicated fix guide. If the oxcart disappears without you pursuing it, resting until the next night and returning to the trigger point is the documented workaround.
gotchas: SOURCE CONFLICT on prerequisites: Fextralife and PowerPyx say 'Nation of the Lambent Flame'; Destructoid says 'Feast of Deception' plus visiting Beastren. The Nation of the Lambent Flame version is the two-source majority.
GAP: no source names the specific main quest that closes this window, despite Fextralife's (!) flag. That field is honest guesswork bounded by Legacy.
The batch brief files this under Battahl; it actually starts in Vermund and ends in Battahl.

name: The Provisioner's Plight
how_to_start: Approach Geoffrey at Borderwatch Outpost; he hails you automatically and asks for help getting provisions to his colleague.
prerequisites: Have started the main quest 'In Dragon's Wake'.
timing: Early game, once 'In Dragon's Wake' has begun. No deadline reported.
bring: 3x Harspud (minimum)
2x Salubrious Draught (minimum) — or the ingredients to craft them
Grapes or apples plus Greenwarish for crafting Salubrious Draughts

best_outcome.summary: Deliver Geoffrey's note and the requested provisions to Markus, then report back.
steps: Talk to Geoffrey at Borderwatch Outpost and take the provisioner's note.
Deliver the note to Markus.
Gather at least 3 Harspuds and 2 Salubrious Draughts. Draughts are crafted, not commonly found: combine grapes or apples with Greenwarish.
Give the Harspuds and Draughts to Markus.
Return to Geoffrey at Borderwatch Outpost to close the quest.

along_the_way: Waterfall Cave near Borderwatch Outpost holds a grimoire chest used by 'Spellbound' — convenient detour from the same hub.
gotchas: Do not sell the provisioner's note. PowerPyx commenters report selling it by accident and stalling the quest; no source confirms whether it can be recovered.
Salubrious Draughts usually have to be CRAFTED (grapes/apples + Greenwarish) rather than bought or found.
No failure branch is documented by any source I reached, so bad_outcome is left null rather than guessed.

name: The Regentkin's Resolve
how_to_start: In the Unmoored World, go to the Stardrop Inn tavern in Vernworth; Captain Brant approaches you and sends you to Sven, now regent, in his chambers on the second floor of Vernworth Castle.
prerequisites: Be in the Unmoored World (post-'Legacy'); the 'Halls of the First Dawn' quest must have been started.
timing: Unmoored World, one of the regional evacuation quests.

missable.window: The Unmoored World runs on a doom timer - the Brine/red fog advances as in-game days pass (commonly cited as roughly 12 in-game days). If Vernworth is consumed before the evacuation, the quest and its region are lost.
missable.warning: Evacuations are on a clock in the Unmoored World - do the region's evacuation quests before resting away too many days, or Vernworth falls with everyone still in it.

bring: The Ornate Box, if you completed the quest that yields it

best_outcome.summary: Resolve Disa and secure the oxcarts so Sven can evacuate the whole Vermund region.
steps: Speak to Brant at the Stardrop Inn, then Sven in his chambers (2F, north-west room of Vernworth Castle).

Handle Disa, in the 2F north-east room. Best option: bring Sven the Ornate Box so her letter reconciles mother and son. Alternatives: grab her (R2/RT) and physically carry her to Sven's chambers, or kill her.

Go to the oxcart station in north-west Vernworth and deal with Allard - tackle/grab him to scare him off the carts, then speak to the merchant Russell. If Allard already died in the 'Every Rose Has Its Thorn' chain, skip straight to Russell.
Return to Sven to start the evacuation.
rewards: Evacuation of Vernworth and other Vermund settlements

bad_outcome.summary: Disa is killed, or the region is left unevacuated.
bad_outcome.how_it_happens: Choosing to kill Disa rather than reuniting her with Sven, or letting the Brine take Vernworth before finishing the quest.
bad_outcome.consequences: Rewards are the same whichever Disa route you take, so the cost of killing her is narrative only. Leaving the region unevacuated loses the settlement and its people for the ending.

along_the_way: Dot Esports calls the Ornate Box the morally best resolution because Disa's letter lets her and Sven reconcile.
gotchas: Game8 and PowerPyx both say 'no time limit mentioned' for this quest specifically; the pressure comes from the Unmoored World's global doom timer, not a per-quest clock. Sources conflict on how strict that timer is - Prima cites 12 in-game days, while players report the fog stops advancing once cities are evacuated and all but the final red beacon are destroyed.
No source gives an exact day count at which Vernworth specifically is lost.
PowerPyx lists only the carry-Disa route; Dot Esports documents all three Disa options.

name: The Sorcerer's Appraisal
how_to_start: Visit Myrddin's home in Checkpoint Rest Town while wearing the Courtly Tunic AND Courtly Breeches. He will not open the door otherwise.
prerequisites: Complete 'Seat of the Sovran'. Obtain the Courtly Tunic and Courtly Breeches — found in Vernworth Castle's Guest Chambers, or from 'The Ornate Box'.
timing: Chapter 1 onward once you have courtly attire and access to Checkpoint Rest Town.

missable.warning: Not flagged missable, but the reward path IS missable: hand Myrddin the forgeries, not the originals, or you lose Trysha's Maister teaching from 'Spellbound' — and Spellbound itself is deleted at Legacy.

bring: Courtly Tunic and Courtly Breeches (worn)
The five grimoires: Let There Be Light, Fulminous Shield, Nation's Death Knell, Howling Blizzard, Towering Earth
Gold for forgeries at Ibrahim's Scrap Store in Bakbattahl

best_outcome.summary: Satisfy both Myrddin and Trysha in one playthrough — forgeries (or the duplicate copy) to Myrddin, originals to Trysha — collecting both Maister teachings.
steps: Gather the five grimoires from across the world.
Have forgeries made at Ibrahim's Scrap Store in Bakbattahl.
Give Myrddin three books; give the genuine articles to Trysha for 'Spellbound'.
PowerPyx notes there are two copies of Nation's Death Knell in the world, so six books total are obtainable — three for each NPC without forging at all.
If you finish Spellbound first, wear the Turquoise Ring Trysha gives you when you return to Myrddin, then rest a few days before he will teach you the spell.

bad_outcome.summary: Give Myrddin the genuine grimoires and you cannot give them to Trysha.
bad_outcome.how_it_happens: Handing over originals without forging copies or without collecting the duplicate Nation's Death Knell.
bad_outcome.consequences: Locks you out of Trysha's Spellbound rewards, including the Celestial Paen spell / Maister's teaching, for that playthrough.

along_the_way: Ibrahim's Scrap Store in Bakbattahl is the forgery vendor for this whole book-and-relic economy.
Spellbound is on Fextralife's Legacy-deletion list, so sequence both before entering the Unmoored World.
gotchas: Fextralife's page for this quest was the one URL I could not fetch (robots block persisted on both the apostrophe and curly-apostrophe forms), so both my sources are secondary. The forgery guidance is consistent across them.
PowerPyx says give Myrddin only three books initially; Game8 describes delivering the set. The three-book split is the one that preserves Spellbound.

name: The Sotted Sage
how_to_start: Reach Geyser Hamlet on Agamen Volcanic Island (via Drabnir's Grotto from Battahl) and approach the hot spring. Lamond calls out to you as you pass, hinting that he wants Newt Liqueur.
prerequisites: Reach Geyser Hamlet / Volcanic Island Camp.
timing: Once you can reach Agamen Volcanic Island.

missable.window: Permanently deleted on entering the Unmoored World via 'Legacy'. No internal countdown.
missable.warning: Do this before 'Legacy' — it is the only way to unlock the Warfarer vocation and its maister skill Rearmament.

bring: 3 Newt Liqueur (5,000 G each from Higgs's Tavern Stand in Bakbattahl — 15,000 G total)
A Beastren Mask from Ibrahim's Scrap Shop if you are not a Beastren

best_outcome.summary: Supply Lamond three Newt Liqueurs, then talk to him once more empty-handed.
steps: Give Lamond one Newt Liqueur; he hands you a Rotten Soft-Boiled Egg.
Buy more from Higgs's Tavern Stand in Bakbattahl (5,000 G each). To get in as a non-Beastren, wear a Beastren Mask and move the satchels outside the tavern into the fenced area.
Deliver until he has had 3 total.
Speak to him again WITHOUT giving liqueur to finish the quest.
rewards: Grandmaster's Path tome → Warfarer maister skill Rearmament
PowerPyx also lists 980 XP and 500 G

bad_outcome.summary: No branching failure is documented.
bad_outcome.how_it_happens: The only loss state is entering the Unmoored World without finishing.
bad_outcome.consequences: Warfarer vocation and Rearmament both become unobtainable on that save.

along_the_way: Gates the Warfarer maister skill Rearmament via the Grandmaster's Path tome — confirmed by both Fextralife and PowerPyx. Counts toward the 'Master of the Maisters' trophy.
Also the only unlock for the Warfarer vocation itself.
Lamond reappears as an evacuation target in 'The Importance of Aiding Ernesto' in the Unmoored World — high affinity with him here makes that quest easier.
gotchas: The final step is talking to Lamond WITHOUT handing over liqueur — Fextralife calls this out explicitly and it is easy to stall on.

CONFLICT on where Lamond is: Fextralife places him at Geyser Hamlet's hot spring; PowerPyx places him at the Volcanic Island Camp hot spring bath, up wooden ramps and a ladder. Both are on the same island; check both if he is not where you expect.

CONFLICT on the Rearmament source: Fextralife says the Grandmaster's Path enables you to learn Rearmament; PowerPyx lists the tome as a reward but does not name the skill. Direction agrees, wording does not.
The Beastren Mask / satchel workaround for tavern entry is only described by these two guides; it is unverified at TU3.2.
15,000 G of liqueur is a real cost — budget before starting.

name: Till Death Do Us Part
how_to_start: Hear the rumour about Ser Ludolph from Oswald, by the fountain in Vernworth's Noble Quarter near Townsend's Estate, then speak to Margit outside Watchhead's Home and choose the dialogue about the nobleman's plot.
prerequisites: Talk to Oswald first — Margit's dialogue does not open otherwise. PowerPyx states the quest becomes available after the main quest 'Seat of the Sovran'.
timing: Mid-game, after Seat of the Sovran / once you can roam Vernworth's Noble Quarter freely. Recommended level 30+.

missable.window: A timer starts the moment you speak to Margit. Gregor can die if too much in-game time passes before you reach him, and the Dullahan at Illdoers' Resting Place only appears at night — it flees at daybreak.
missable.warning: Once you talk to Margit the clock is running — go straight to Illdoers' Resting Place in the Misty Marshes, and arrive at night or the Dullahan escapes.

bring: A Wakestone (revives Gregor if he falls and salvages the best outcome)
Palladium or another damage-negation buff; avoid ice — the Dullahan resists it
Night-travel lighting

best_outcome.summary: Reach Gregor at night, keep him alive through the Dullahan fight, and report back to Margit.
steps: Speak to Oswald, then Margit at Watchhead's Home.
Travel immediately to Illdoers' Resting Place in the Misty Marshes, arriving at night.
Aid Gregor against the Dullahan — deal damage and survive, but do not land the kill yourself.
Keep Gregor alive; if he falls, use a Wakestone on him before leaving.
Return to Margit.

bad_outcome.summary: Gregor dies and is not revived.
bad_outcome.how_it_happens: Taking too long after speaking to Margit, or letting him fall in the Dullahan fight without a Wakestone.
bad_outcome.consequences: You lose the Lustrous Targe; the quest updates to have you break the news to Margit instead. XP, gold and Steeled Virtue are still awarded.

along_the_way: Killing the Dullahan before dawn is tied to the bronze trophy 'Before Dawn Breaks' (PowerPyx).
gotchas: CONFLICT on prerequisite: Fextralife lists 'The Nameless Village' as a possible requirement but flags player reports that it is optional; PowerPyx instead ties availability to 'Seat of the Sovran'.

CONFLICT on recovery: Fextralife says a Wakestone revives Gregor post-battle for the best outcome; PowerPyx comments say you can also carry his body back to Vernworth and revive him there. Both point the same direction — do not leave his body behind.

Fextralife says to avoid killing the Dullahan yourself; PowerPyx frames killing it before dawn as the trophy condition. These may be different objectives (quest outcome vs trophy) but the guides do not reconcile them — do not assume.

name: Tolled to Rest
region: Vermund (Ancient Battleground, northwest of Harve Village)
how_to_start: Rescue Oskar from monsters on the road to the Ancient Battleground, northwest of Harve Village, then speak to him.
prerequisites: Save Oskar from the enemies attacking him.

missable.window: Unavailable after completing the main quest 'Legacy' (Unmoored World transition).
missable.warning: BLUNT: on Game8's after-'Legacy' cutoff list. It also gates the Ancient Battleground Key and the grimoire that TWO other quests need. Missing this cascades.

bring: Escort-fight kit — Oskar must survive the walk
Check your inventory AND storage for the grimoire 'Nation's Death Knell' before starting

best_outcome.summary: Escort Oskar safely, hand over the grimoire, and take the Ancient Battleground Key.
steps: Escort Oskar to his destination, protecting him from monsters.
Find the grimoire 'Nation's Death Knell' near the bell.
Give the grimoire to Oskar. He rings the bell.
Use the Ancient Battleground Key on the locked door for extra treasure.

along_the_way: The Ancient Battleground is also where 'Off the Pilfered Path' requires you to wipe out the Coral Snakes — bundle the trips.
gotchas: If you explored the Ancient Battleground earlier you may ALREADY have the grimoire sitting in inventory or storage, which makes the objective look broken. Check both.
The grimoire feeds 'Spellbound' and 'The Sorcerer's Appraisal' — do not sell or misplace it.
Single-source (Game8) on rewards; missable status corroborated by Game8's separate missables page.

name: Trouble on the Cape
how_to_start: Go to Harve Village during the 'Readvent of Calamity' chain and find Ulrika; a scene triggers in which she argues with Jonas and Fyoran, then runs off to Stormwind Cave after the captured villager Zoran.
prerequisites: 'Readvent of Calamity' in progress and 'Scaly Invaders' completed (Game8).
timing: Vermund, during the Readvent of Calamity chain, before the Vernworth story reaches Feast of Deception.

missable.window: Fextralife marks it time-limited and cancelled if not picked up in time but does not state the exact deadline; it sits inside the 'Readvent of Calamity' chain, which is deleted when 'Feast of Deception' completes.
missable.warning: Start this before finishing Feast of Deception, and do NOT enter Stormwind Cave until Ulrika has formally started the quest or you can lock yourself into the worse ending.

best_outcome.summary: Let Ulrika lead the rescue, save Zoran from the saurians and escort him home - Ulrika becomes chief of Harve and Fyoran is exiled.
steps: Trigger the argument scene by finding Ulrika in Harve Village.
Travel with Ulrika and the guards to Stormwind Cave south of Harve.
Push into the deeper part of the cave and find Zoran under attack by saurians.
Kill the saurians without letting Zoran die.
Escort Zoran back to Harve Village.
rewards: Ulrika installed as village chief; unlocks 'Home Is Where the Hearth Is'

bad_outcome.summary: The rescue happens without Ulrika.
bad_outcome.how_it_happens: Entering Stormwind Cave and clearing it before Ulrika officially starts the quest - a known bug/sequence break.
bad_outcome.consequences: Ulrika stays an ordinary NPC instead of becoming chief, and the village chief drives everyone out instead. This degrades the Harve ending and jeopardises the Ulrika chain.

gotchas: Sources conflict on missability: Game8's quest page says no explicit time limit and does not list it among timed quests, while Fextralife marks it time-limited and Fextralife's master list flags it. Fextralife is treated as authoritative here.
No source states the precise number of in-game days before cancellation.
Sources differ on whether the reward is a Ferrystone or a Dragon Ferrystone.

name: Vocation Frustration
how_to_start: Go to the Vernworth Vocation Guild (below Shakir's Inn), interact with Klaus and choose 'Talk'. He wants demonstration weapons for the advanced vocations.
prerequisites: Complete the main quest 'Seat of the Sovran'.
timing: After 'Seat of the Sovran' and before 'Feast of Deception'. That is the entire available window.

missable.window: Opens after 'Seat of the Sovran'; permanently deleted when you complete the main quest 'Feast of Deception'.
missable.warning: Do this before 'Feast of Deception' — that main quest wipes it, and with it the earliest unlock of the Warrior and Sorcerer vocations.

bring: Curatives for the Trevo Mine goblins
Enough carry weight for a Greatsword and an Archistaff

best_outcome.summary: Fetch a Greatsword and an Archistaff from Trevo Mine and bring both back to Klaus, unlocking the Warrior and Sorcerer vocations.
steps: Talk to Klaus at the Vernworth Vocation Guild below Shakir's Inn.
Speak with Roderick at his smithy as directed.
Travel on foot west of Vernworth to Trevo Mine.
Retrieve the Greatsword from the chest past the narrow passage.
Descend to B1F and find the Archistaff in the northeast tunnel; clear the goblins there first so you can loot the chest safely.
Return both weapons to Klaus.
rewards: Advanced Vocations: The Warrior and the Sorcerer (unlocks both vocations)

bad_outcome.summary: The quest is lost outright at 'Feast of Deception'.
bad_outcome.how_it_happens: Completing the main quest 'Feast of Deception' with Vocation Frustration unstarted or unfinished.
bad_outcome.consequences: The quest disappears permanently along with its 7,500 G, 1,200 XP and its unlock of the Warrior and Sorcerer vocations from this source. (Fextralife's master list is the authority for the deletion; no walkthrough source I could reach mentions it.)

along_the_way: Trevo Mine is a goblin-heavy dungeon west of Vernworth with its own chests worth sweeping while you are inside.
gotchas: SOURCES CONFLICT on missability: Fextralife's master list places Vocation Frustration among the quests deleted by 'Feast of Deception', while Game8 and PowerPyx both list no missable warning at all. The project's ground truth treats Fextralife as authoritative, so it is recorded as missable here.
Trevo Mine must be reached on foot — no oxcart route.
Clear the B1F goblins before opening the Archistaff chest or you will be looting under fire.
sources: Fextralife master side-quest list (points-of-no-return table) — supplied as project ground truth; page itself robots-blocked to fetch

name: Wandering Roots
how_to_start: Talk to Glyndwr, an elven archer on the entrance platform of Sacred Arbor, in the Unmoored World after 'Halls of the First Dawn' is started/completed.
prerequisites: Be in the Unmoored World with 'Halls of the First Dawn' underway. The clean route additionally needs 'The Ailing Arborheart' and 'Out of the Forest, Into the Forge'. A pawn with the Woodland Wordsmith / Elvish specialisation is effectively required to understand Taliesin.
timing: Post-game only, inside the Unmoored World. One of the five evacuation quests for the true ending.
bring: A pawn with the Woodland Wordsmith (Elvish) specialisation
The Arborheart cutting, if taking the primary route

best_outcome.summary: Convince the elder Taliesin to let Sacred Arbor's elves evacuate.
steps: Hire or bring a pawn with Elvish translation before you go.
Talk to Glyndwr at the Sacred Arbor entrance platform.
PRIMARY ROUTE: complete 'The Ailing Arborheart' and 'Out of the Forest, Into the Forge', plant the Arborheart cutting at the Seafloor Shrine, then return to Taliesin — he agrees to evacuate.
ALTERNATIVE ROUTE: skip that chain and wear Taliesin down by talking. Sleep at the nearby inn and speak to him again after each rest — PowerPyx says roughly three rests.
Confirm the evacuation with Taliesin.

bad_outcome.summary: Sacred Arbor is never evacuated.
bad_outcome.how_it_happens: Ending the game via 'When Wills Collide', or letting the Unmoored World's ~10-day rest budget run out, with the quest unfinished.
bad_outcome.consequences: The elves are not evacuated and that region's true-ending requirement goes unmet. No in-quest failure branch is documented.

along_the_way: Lesser Dragons spawn nearby and are worth farming during the forced waiting periods on the dialogue route.
'The Ailing Arborheart' and 'Out of the Forest, Into the Forge' are worth doing on their own merits and make this quest resolve in one step.
gotchas: The alternative dialogue route costs in-game SLEEPS, and sleeps are exactly what advance the Unmoored World's ~10-day destruction clock. If you are tight on days, take the Arborheart route instead.
Without an Elvish-speaking pawn, Taliesin's dialogue is unreadable; Game8 treats the translation as effectively required, PowerPyx as strongly recommended.

Game8 explicitly calls this quest NOT missable because two completion routes exist, and Fextralife does not flag it (!). The Unmoored World's global clock still applies, which is why the bad_outcome is filled in even though is_missable is false.

name: Welcome to Battahl
how_to_start: Triggered on entering the Mercantile Ward of Bakbattahl - Roger accosts you at/near the Wanderer's Haven tavern and sets his thugs on you.
prerequisites: Access to Bakbattahl via the main quest 'Nation of Lambent Flame'.
timing: Immediately on first entering Bakbattahl's Mercantile Ward.

missable.window: Closes permanently once the main quest 'A New Godsway' completes.
missable.warning: Settle this bar-brawl duel before you finish A New Godsway, or you lose the quest and the Fruit Wine the Warfarer unlock chain wants.

best_outcome.summary: Beat Roger's thugs, then win the one-on-one duel against Taleef with Raghnall betting on you.
steps: Let Roger's three ruffians attack and defeat them.
The sellsword Raghnall steps in and evens the odds.
Fight Taleef one-on-one - he is a Warrior with slow, heavily telegraphed swings, so dodge and punish.
Win the duel.
rewards: Fruit Wine (needed later for 'The Sotted Sage')

bad_outcome.summary: You lose the duel to Taleef.
bad_outcome.how_it_happens: Getting knocked out in the one-on-one fight.
bad_outcome.consequences: The quest still completes, but you get only the XP, no Fruit Wine and no gold bonus, and Raghnall's lost bet costs you 3,000 Gold.

gotchas: Losing forfeits the Fruit Wine, which feeds 'The Sotted Sage' and the Warfarer vocation chain. 'The Sotted Sage' is itself deleted at Legacy, so a loss here can cascade.
Game8's quest page does not flag this as missable; Fextralife's master list does (lost after A New Godsway). Fextralife is treated as authoritative here.
